description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Team The Self-Serve Business Regional Team (SSBU) is on a mission to build a sustainable and scalable ecosystem for B2B customers. We aim to maximize the Lifetime Value (LTV) of B2B customers, driving substantial, repeatable, and forecastable growth in Grab's revenue and profitability. We achieve this by leveraging technology and building business models across multiple products, including Grab for Business (GFB).
